lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgSi₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/amd (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—4 Mg and 8 Si—distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each Mg center has 12 Si neighbors, and each Si center has 12 neighbors (4 Mg and 8 Si), with neighbor distances ranging from 2.8249 to 3.1673 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg–Si, Si–Si, and Mg–Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
